project.description: The one shape of an engine: a function that is handed an object's state with what is round it, the tick and the tick's events, and gives the state a tick on with an explanation of what it worked out, in a type of its own, and what it says happened. An engine keeps nothing between ticks and reads nothing but what it is handed. A correction is a further function of the same shape, handed the step before's result and what is new for this step. Explaining is switched on or off once, when a run begins.
